name: wb_version_restore
description: Restore a document to one of its saved versions — in place by default, into another path with targetPath, or the document and every descendant with subtree. Nothing rewinds: the restore is a new edit whose result equals the saved state.

workspaceId.description: Workspace id, <handle>/<segment>, or a segment of your own.

documentId.description: Document ID (ULID) whose history holds the version. Restored onto itself unless targetPath is given.

versionId.description: Version id (`version.id`) returned by wb_version_save or wb_version_list.

targetPath.description: Restore into this path instead of in place: a path not yet taken becomes a new document holding the saved state; an existing one needs overwrite: true, is reconciled in place, and must be the same kind as the saved state.

overwrite.description: Required to restore onto a targetPath that already holds a document.

subtree.description: Roll the document AND every descendant back to this version — needs a version saved with the whole workspace (every version this history records is). Not combinable with targetPath.

annotations.title: Restore a document from a version

documentId.description: The document holding the restored state: the one addressed for in-place and subtree, the document at targetPath (new or overwritten, not the source) for into-target.
